messages.content: Teach the historical Series 1600 and Intellivision programming material precisely and concisely.
A pointer in R4 stores three consecutive words using MVO@. What happens to R4?
R4 auto-increments after each indirect store, so it advances by three word addresses.
Teach the historical Series 1600 and Intellivision programming material precisely and concisely.
Choose RES or ZERO for unused ROM space that must have defined contents, and explain why.
Use ZERO. It allocates and initializes the space, whereas RES leaves its contents undefined; the ROM generator warns about undefined, non-sequential locations.

Why must a routine save R5 before using JSR R5, target when it still needs its caller return address?
JSR writes its return address to R5. Saving R5 first, commonly via the R6 stack, preserves the caller's return path.

A project has two relocatable modules. One declares a symbol global and the other declares it external. Which tool resolves that connection?
S16LNK resolves the global definition against the external reference while linking the relocatable object modules.

What is the practical difference between an S16SIM trace and a trap on a memory address?
A trace reports qualifying activity while execution continues. A trap suspends execution when the qualifying access or change occurs.

A program must clear the full 20×12 Intellivision card screen through the EXEC. Which values are prepared?
Set R4 to BACKTAB start $0200 and R0 to decimal 240, then call the sample's clear-memory EXEC routine at $1738.

Can an S16XAL expression use parentheses to force addition before subtraction?
No. Expressions use only + and -, have at most six elements, and evaluate from left to right without parenthetical grouping.

In color-stack mode, why can two pastel colors coexist on one card when they cannot under foreground/background mode?
Color-stack mode can supply either stack color and a foreground color without requiring a primary. Foreground/background mode requires one of the card's two colors to be primary.

Which S16SIM register trap best acts as a code breakpoint, and why?
Trap R7, because R7 is the program counter; its activity tracks instruction flow.

How should a source line begin if it has an operator but no label?
Begin it with at least one blank before the operator.

Which directive emits two packed seven-bit ASCII characters per word, and in which byte order?
TEXT; it packs the first character into the low byte and the second into the high byte.

What does MVI@ R6, R7 accomplish in the tutorial's return path?
It performs a stack-style indirect read through R6 and places the saved return address in R7, resuming execution at that address.
